  SELECT 
    v.order_id, 
    AVG(r.review_score) AS calif, 
    julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) AS dias_retraso,
    CASE 
      WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) <= 0 THEN 'a_tiempo'
      WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 3 THEN '1-3'
      WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) BETWEEN 3 AND 7 THEN '4-7'
      WHEN julianday(v.order_delivered_customer_date) - julianday(v.order_estimated_delivery_date) BETWEEN 7 AND 14 THEN '8-14'
      ELSE '15+'
    END AS rango_retraso
  FROM vw_pedidos_validos v
  JOIN order_reviews r ON r.order_id = v.order_id
  WHERE v.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY v.order_id
)
SELECT 
  rango_retraso, 
  COUNT(*) AS pedidos, 
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS pct_2_o_menos,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN calif <= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),

  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(oi.freight_value) / SUM(oi.price), 2) AS pct_flete,

JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = v.order_id
